item.title: Blakeman calls Hochul Mamdani's 'puppet' at New York rally
item.description: Bruce Blakeman called Kathy Hochul a "puppet" of Zohran Mamdani at a campaign rally, accusing both of failing on crime and illegal immigration.

item.title: CA Senator Previews the Schiff Show We'll See If Democrats Win Midterms
Nicki Minaj pledges support for Trump again at Michigan GOP rally
item.description: Nicki Minaj told President Donald Trump she would support him forever at a Michigan rally backing Mike Rogers and John James in the midterms.

item.title: Trump's influence seen in Latin America's rightward shift as Brazil becomes next test
item.description: Trump's political influence is fueling right-leaning shifts across Latin American countries, with Javier Milei leading Argentina's charge.
